notes: The bot knows your characters: say "make my shaman tankier" or use a character's name and it uses that character's class, level and gear; it can also level up characters and save builds to them. Goal mix: mostly one goal plus some of another (e.g. 70% spell damage + 30% survival). Mana check for spell builds: whether you can cast at full speed forever, or for how long. Armor powders are now part of the best build (they add health, so tanky builds get stronger).
